712503.full: συν-οχή, -ῆς, ή (συνέχω), [in LXX: Jdg.2:3 (?), Job.30:3 (שׁוֹא), Job.38:28 A; Mic.5:1 (4:14), Jer.52:5 (מָצוֹר) * ;] __1. a holding or being held together. __2. a narrow place (Hom., al.). Metaphorical, straits, distress: Luk.21:25; καρδίας, 2Co.2:4.† (AS)

s: a regular collection of writings, a work, book, doctrine
712505.full: 1. that which is put together in order : 2. a body of troops, squadron, contingent , (Xenophon Historicus) 3. the constitution of a state , ς. πολιτείας a form of constitution, (Isocrates Orator) 4. an arrangement of musical notes , (Aristotle Philosopher) 5. a regular collection of writings, a work, book, doctrine , (Plutarch) 6. = σύνταξις II. 3, (Aeschines Orator) (ML)

712506.full: 1. a putting together, arranging, arrangement, organisation, order , (Thucydides): rule , (Demosthenes Orator) 2. a systematic treatise , (Aristotle Philosopher): a narrative , (Polybius Historicus) 3. grammatical construction, syntax , (Lucian) 4. a body of troops , ἡ εἰς μυρίους ς. their contingent towards 10, 000, (Xenophon Historicus) 5. a covenant, contract , (Demosthenes Orator) 6. an assigned impost, contribution , (Demosthenes Orator) 7. a payment, allowance, pension , (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

s: to be confounded, greatly troubled, much distressed
712507.full: to throw all together into confusion, to confound, disturb, trouble , Lat. conturbare, (Iliad by Homer), attic:—;Pass., αἰθὴρ πόντῳ ξυντετάρακται air is confounded with sea, (Aeschulus Tragicus): to be thrown into confusion , of soldiers, (Thucydides); of social order, (Sophocles Tragicus); metaphorically of persons, to be confounded, greatly troubled, much distressed , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

712508.lxx: in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi.
712508.full: συν-τάσσω [in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;] to prescribe, ordain, arrange: with dative of person(s), Mat.21:6 26:19 27:10" (LXX) .† (AS)

712509.lxx: in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה and (in Da) for קוּם
712509.full: συντέλεια, -ας, ἡ (συντελέω), [in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה and (in Da) for קוּם ;] __1. in cl., a joint payment or contribution for public service; hence, generally, joint action (Plat.). __2. In late writers (Polyb., al.), consummation, completion: σ. τ. αἰῶνος, -ων (cf. Dan LXX TH Dan.12:13, al.), Mat.13:39-40, 49 24:3 28:20, Heb.9:26.† (AS)

s: to complete, finish, bring to an end
to effect, accomplish, bring to fulfilment
712510.lxx: in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה pi., also for עָשָׂה, תָּמַם, etc.
712510.full: συν-τελέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה pi., also for עָשָׂה, תָּמַם, etc. ;] "perfective" of τελέω (cf. M, Pr., 118), __1. to complete, finish, bring to an end: Luk.4:13; pass., Luk.4:2, Jhn.2:3, WH, mg., Act.21:27. __2. to effect, accomplish, bring to fulfilment (cf. MM, xxiv): Mrk.13:4, Rom.9:28, Heb.8:8.† (AS)

712511.full: συν-τέμνω [in LXX chiefly for חָרַץ ;] __1. to cut in pieces. __2. to cut down, cut short: metapb., λόγον, Rom.9:28 (LXX) (Hdt., Plat., Fur., al.).† (AS)

s: to preserve, keep safe, keep close
712512.lxx: in LXX: Eze.18:19 (שָׁמַר), Da TH Dan.7:28 A (נְטַר), Sir.13:12 and freq., Tob.1:11, 2Ma.12:42, al.
712512.full: συν-τηρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: Eze.18:19 (שָׁמַר), Da TH Dan.7:28 A (נְטַר), Sir.13:12 and freq., Tob.1:11, 2Ma.12:42, al. ;] "perfective" of τηρέω (see M, Pr., 113, 116), to preserve, keep safe, keep close: with accusative of person(s), Mrk.6:20; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.9:17; ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Luk.2:19 (Arist. and later writers; cf. MM, xxiv).† (AS)

712513.full: συν-τίθημι [in LXX: 1Ki.22:13 (קָשַׁר), etc. ;] to place or put together, in various senses. Mid., __(a) to observe, perceive; __(b) to determine, agree, covenant: with inf., Luk.22:5; before τοῦ, with inf., Act.23:20; before ἵνα, Jhn.9:22.† συν-επι-τίθημι, [in LXX for שִׁית, etc. ;] to help in putting on. Mid., to join in attacking (Thuc.): Act.24:9 (RV, joined in the charge).† (AS)

712516.full: συν-τόμως, adv. (συντέμνω) [in LXX: Pro.13:23 23:28, 3Ma.5:25 * ;] concisely, briefly: Act.24:4 (for a similar ex., see MM, xxiv).† (AS)

712518.full: συν-τρέχω [in LXX: Psa.50:18 (עִם רָצָה), עִם רָצָה), 2Ma.2:1-32, Jdt.4.1-15 * ;] to run together or with: before ἐκεῖ, Mrk.6:33; πρόσ, with accusative, Act.3:11; metaphorically, 1Pe.4:4.† (AS)

712520.full: συν-τρίβω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁבַר ;] to shatter, break in pieces: Mat.12:20 (LXX), Mrk.5:4 14:3, Jhn.19:36" (LXX), Rev.2:27; of persons and parts of the body, to break, crush, bruise: Luk.9:39; figuratively, Rom.16:20.† (AS)

712521.lxx: in LXX (Lev.21:19, al.) chiefly for שֶׁבֶר; also for שֹׁד (Isa.59:7), etc.
712521.full: σύν-τριμμα, -τος, τό (συντρίβω), [in LXX (Lev.21:19, al.) chiefly for שֶׁבֶר; also for שֹׁד (Isa.59:7), etc. ;] a fracture (Arist.; Le, l.with, al.). Metaphorical, calamity, destruction (Isa, l.with, Wis.3:3, al.): Rom.3:16" (LXX) .† (AS)

s: one nourished or brought up with, a foster-brother
In Hellenistic usage, as a court term, an intimate friend of a king
712525.full: σύν-τροφος, -ου, ὁ (συντρέφομαι, to be brought up together) [in LXX: 3Ki.12:24, 1Ma.1:6 R, 2Ma.9:29 * ;] __1. prop., one nourished or brought up with, a foster-brother: Act.13:1 EV. __2. In Hellenistic usage, as a court term, an intimate friend of a king (see Deiss., BS, 305, 310 f.): Act.13:1 (cf. also MM, xxiv).† (AS)

s: to meet with, fall in with
712527.full: συν-τυγχάνω [in LXX: 2Ma.8:14 * ;] to meet with, fall in with: with dative of person(s), Luk.8:19.† (AS)

s: to frame with art, devise cunningly
712528.full: to weave together : metaphorically to frame with art, devise cunningly , (Odyssey by Homer):—;Pass., ὥστε ταῦτα συνυφανθῆναι so that this web was woven , i. e. this business undertaken, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

s: a musical pipe, a shepherd's pipe, Panspipe
the hole in the nave of a wheel
712537.full: 1. a pipe : 2. a musical pipe, a shepherd's pipe, Panspipe , (Iliad by Homer), attic 3. anything like a pipe : 4. a spear-case , = δορατοθήκη, (Iliad by Homer) 5. the hole in the nave of a wheel , [variant datesTragica Adespota 6. a duct or channel in the body, in plural the nostrils , (Sophocles Tragicus) (ML)

712538.full: 1. to play the σῦριγξ, to pipe , (Euripides); with accusative cognate, συρίζων ὑμεναίους (Euripides) 2. to whistle, hiss , (Aeschulus Tragicus):—;with accusative cognate, συρίζων φόνον hissing forth murder, (Aeschulus Tragicus) 3. to hiss an actor, Lat. explodere, (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

712541.full: Σύρος, -ου, ὁ, fem. Σύρα a Syrian: Luk.4:27, Mrk.7:26, WH, mg.† (AS)

712542.full: to sew or stitch together, sew up , Lat. consuo, (Hesiod) (ML)

712543.full: σύρω [in LXX: 4Ki.17:13 (סָחַב), 4Ma.6:1, al. ;] to draw, drag: with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.21:8, Rev.12:4; with accusative of person(s), of taking to trial or punish­ment, Act.8:3; ἔξω τ. πόλεως, Act.14:19; ἐπὶ τ. πολιτάρχας (cf. 4Mac, l.with), Act.17:6 (cf. κατα-ούρω).† (AS)

712547.full: one who lives in the same tent, a messmate , Lat. contubernalis, (Thucydides) (ML)

712549.full: 1. to shade quite over, throw a shade over, shade closely or thickly , (Hesiod); γένυν ς., i. e.to get a beard, (Euripides): metaphorically, συσκηνῶσαι τὰς ἁμαρτίας (Demosthenes Orator) 2. intransitive to be thick-shaded , (Euripides) (ML)

712550.full: closely shaded, thickly shaded , (Xenophon Historicus); σύσκιόν τι a closely-shaded place , (Lucian) (ML)

712551.full: to grow quite dark : impersonal, συσκοτάζει it grows dark , (Thucydides) (ML)

712552.full: 1. to draw together, draw up, contract , (Plato Philosophus) 2. to draw together by stitching, sew together , (Xenophon Historicus) 3. in Mid. to draw along with one , (Plutarch) (ML)

712555.full: σύσ-σημον (T, συν-), -ου, τό (σῆμα), [in LXX: Jdg.20:38, 40 (מַשְׂאֵת), Isa.5:26 49:22 62:10 (נֵס) * ;] a fixed sign or signal: Mrk.14:44. (Strab., Plut., al.; condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 492 f.) † (AS)

s: a meeting, a knot of men
712557.full: 1. a putting together, composition , (Aristotle Philosopher); ς. προσώπου a studied expression of countenance, of Pericles, (Plutarch) 2. a bringing together, introduction, recommendation , (Polybius Historicus) 3. συνίσταμαι); a standing together, meeting : in hostile sense, close combat, conflict , (Herdotus Historicus); metaphorically, ς. γνώμης a conflict of mind, intense anxiety, (Thucydides) 4. a meeting, a knot of men , (Euripides); κατὰ ξυστάσεις γιγνόμενοι forming into knots , (Thucydides): a political union , (Demosthenes Orator) 5. friendship or alliance , (Polybius Historicus): a conspiracy , (Plutarch) 6. construction, structure, constitution , (Plato Philosophus): absolute a political constitution , (Plato Philosophus) 7. metaphorically of the mind, ς. φρενῶν contraction, sternness, sullenness , (Euripides) (ML)

712558.lxx: in LXX: Jdg.8:28 11:33 (כָּנַע ni.), Sir.4:31, al.
712558.full: συν-στέλλω (Rec. συσ-), [in LXX: Jdg.8:28 11:33 (כָּנַע ni.), Sir.4:31, al. ;] __1. to draw together, contract, shorten: of time, 1Co.7:29. __2. to wrap up: of enshrouding a body for burial (Eur.), with accusative, Act.5:6.† (AS)

s: a body of soldiers, a corps
712560.full: 1. a whole compounded of parts, a system , (Plato Philosophus):—; a composition , (Aristotle Philosopher) 2. an organised government, constitution , (Aristotle Philosopher) 3. a body of soldiers, a corps , (Polybius Historicus) 4. of the Roman Senate, (Plutarch) (ML)

712561.full: anything twisted up together: a body of men, a crowd, concourse , (Polybius Historicus) from συστρέφω (ML)

712562.full: συ-στέφω [in LXX chiefly for קָשַׁר ;] __1. to twist together: with accusative of thing(s), Act.28:3. __2. Pass., of persons, to gather themselves together: Mat.17:22 (WH, R, mg.).† (AS)

712563.lxx: in LXX: Rom.4:19 13:12 (צָרַר); σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Amo.7:10 (קָשַׁר), etc.
712563.full: συ-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ (συστρέφω), [in LXX: Rom.4:19 13:12 (צָרַר); σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Amo.7:10 (קָשַׁר), etc. ;] __1. a twisting together (Plat.). __2. a concourse, a riotous gathering (Polyb.): Act.19:40; σ. ποιεῖσθαι (Am, l.with), to make a compact (RV, banded themselves together): Act.23:12.† (AS)

712565.full: Συχέμ indecl. (Heb. שְׁכֶם), Shechem; __1. the son of Hamor (Gen.33:19): Act.7:16 b, Rec. __2. A city of Samaria (AV, Sychem; in LXX also sometimes Σίκιμα, -ων, as in FlJ): Act.7:16 a,b.† (AS)

712568.lxx: in LXX for טָבַח, הֲרֵגָה, etc.
712568.full: σφαγή, -ῆς, ἡ (σφάζω), [in LXX for טָבַח, הֲרֵגָה, etc. ;] slaughter: Act.8:32 (LXX); πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Rom.8:36 (LXX); ἡμέρα σφαγῆς, Jas.5:5.† (AS)

712570.full: σφάγιον, -ου, τό (σφαγή), [in LXX: Amo.5:25 (זֶבַח), Eze.21:10, 15 21:28 (טֶבַח), Lev.22:23 (נְדָבָה) * ;] a victim for slaughter: Act.7:42 (LXX).† (AS)

712571.full: σφάζω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַט ;] to slay, slaughter (esp. of victims for sacrifice): ἀρνίον, Rev.5:6, 12 13:8; of persons, 1Jn.3:12, Rev.5:9 6:4, 9 18:24; ἐσφαγμένη εἰς θάνατον (RV, smitten unto death), Rev.13:3 (cf. κατα-σφάζω).† (AS)

712573.full: to be gangrened , ἐσφακέλισε τὸ ὀστέον (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

s: ready to fall, tottering, reeling, staggering
712574.full: 1. likely to make one stumble or trip : metaphorically slippery, perilous, dangerous , Lat. lubricus, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.:—; σφαλερόν [ ἐστι], with infinitive, it is dangerous to . ., (Plato Philosophus), etc. 2. σφάλλομαι); ready to fall, tottering, reeling, staggering , (Aeschulus Tragicus); σφ. σύμμαχοι (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

s: by tripping up, to trip up in wrestling
712575.full: 1. Lat. fall-o (the sigma being lost):—; to make to fall, throw down, overthrow , properly by tripping up, to trip up in wrestling , (Homer), etc.; σφ. ναῦς to throw her on her beam-ends , (Plutarch); ἵππος σφ. τὸν ἀναβάτην throws him, (Xenophon Historicus):—;Pass. to be tripped up , (Aristophanes Comicus); of a drunken man, σφαλλόμενος reeling, staggering , (Aristophanes Comicus) 2. generally, to cause to fall, overthrow, defeat , (Herdotus Historicus):—;Pass. to be overthrown, to fall, fail, be undone, become helpless , (Herdotus Historicus), attic; τόδ᾽ ἐσφάλη this mishap took place , (Sophocles Tragicus); οὔ τι μὴ σφαλῶ γ᾽ ἐν σοί I shall not fail in thy business, (Sophocles Tragicus) 3. to baffle, foil, balk, disappoint , (Herdotus Historicus):—;Pass. to err, go wrong, be mistaken , (Herdotus Historicus) 4. the Pass. is also used with genitive rei, to be balked of or foiled in a thing, ἦ καὶ πατήρ τι σφάλλεται βουλευμάτω; (Aeschulus Tragicus); σφάλλεσθαι γάμου (Euripides); τῆς δόξης (Thucydides) (ML)

s: to throw as from a sling
to move like a swing, to swing to and fro
712577.full: 1. to sling, to use the sling , (Thucydides) 2. to strike by slinging , (Babrius Fabularum Scriptor) 3. to throw as from a sling :—;Pass., (Euripides) 4. to move like a swing, to swing to and fro , (Euripides) from σφενδόνη (ML)

s: in which the stone was set
the broader part round the stone
712578.full: 1. Lat. funda (the ς being lost), a sling , (Iliad by Homer): metaphorically, σφενδόνας ἀπ᾽ εὐμέτρου with well-measured throw, as from a sling , (Aeschulus Tragicus) 2. the hoop of a ring in which the stone was set as in a sling, especially the broader part round the stone , as in Lat. funda for pala annuli , (Euripides) 3. the stone or bullet of the sling , (Xenophon Historicus); τοιαύταις σφ., of hailstones, (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

712581.full: a wedge , (Aristophanes Comicus), etc.;—;used as an instrument of torture , (Aeschulus Tragicus) (ML)

712585.full: to bind tight, bind fast , (Aeschulus Tragicus):—;Pass., (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus) (ML)

712586.full: σφόδρα adv. (prop. neut. of σφοδρός, excessive, violent) [in LXX chiefly for מְאֹד ;] very, very much, exceedingly: with verbs, Mat.17:6, 23 18:31 19:25 26:22 27:54, Act.6:7; with adjectives, Mat.2:10, Mrk.16:4, Luk.18:23, Rev.16:21.† (AS)

712587.full: 1. vehement, violent, excessive , (Thucydides), etc. 2. of men, violent, impetuous , (Plato Philosophus): also strong, robust , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

712589.full: 1. a vertebra , (Aristophanes Comicus):—;in plural the backbone, spine , or the neck , (Euripides) 2. Lat. verticillus, the round weight attached to a spindle, (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

712590.lxx: in LXX chiefly for חָתַם (Deu.32:34, al.), also for סָתַם (Da TH Dan.8:26)
712590.full: σφραγίζω [in LXX chiefly for חָתַם (Deu.32:34, al.), also for סָתַם (Da TH Dan.8:26) ;] to seal, __(a) for security: Mat.27:66, Rev.20:3; τ. καρπὸν τοῦτον, figuratively (cf. Deiss., BS, 238 f.; MM, xxiv; DB, iv, 427a), Rom.15:28; __(b) for concealment, hence, metaphorically, to hide (Da TH Dan.9:24, Jhn.14:17): Rev.10:4 22:10; __(with) for distinction, Rev.7:3-8; metaphorically, Eph.4:30; mid., 2Co.1:22; __(d) for authentication (Est.8:8): Jhn.3:33 6:27 (cf. κατα-σφραγίζω).† (AS)

s: The impression of a seal or signet, a seal
712591.lxx: in LXX: Exo.28:11, al. (חוֹתָם) Exo.35:22 (חָח), Sir.17:22, al.
712591.full: σφραγίς, -ῖδος, ἡ [in LXX: Exo.28:11, al. (חוֹתָם) Exo.35:22 (חָח), Sir.17:22, al. ;] __1. a seal, signet: Rev.7:2. __2. The impression of a seal or signet, a seal (on its various purposes, see: σφραγίζω): on a book or roll, Rev.5:1-2, 5 5:9 6:1, 3 6:5, 7 6:9, 12 8:1; metaphorically, Rom.4:11, 1Co.9:2, 2Ti.2:19, Rev.9:4.† (AS)

712592.full: 1. a hammer , (Odyssey by Homer) 2. a beetle, mallet , for breaking clods of earth, (Hesiod) (ML)

712595.full: 1. properly to let loose : hence to slit, open , (Aristophanes Comicus); σχ. φλέβα to open a vein, (Xenophon Historicus), etc.:—;of flowers, σχ. κάλυκας [variant datesAnthology Palantina 2. to let fall, drop , (Xenophon Historicus) 3. to let go , σχάσας τὴν φροντίδα having let the mind go, given it play , (Aristophanes Comicus); σχ. τὰς μηχανάς to let off the engines, (Plutarch) 4. to check, stop, stay , Lat. inhibere, κώπαν σχάσον, i. e. cease rowing, (Pindar); σχάσον ὄμμα lower thine eyes, (Euripides):—;Mid., σχασάμενος τὴν ἱππικήν having dropt one's horsemanship, "given up the turf," (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

712596.full: 1. a raft, float (such as was made off-hand , compare σχέδιος II), (Odyssey by Homer); generally, a boat, ship , (Euripides) 2. a bridge of boats , of the bridge of Xerxes, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

712597.full: 1. a raft, float (such as was made off-hand , compare σχέδιος II), (Odyssey by Homer); generally, a boat, ship , (Euripides) 2. a bridge of boats , of the bridge of Xerxes, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

712598.full: σχέδον adv. (ἔχω), [in LXX: 2Ma.5:2, 3Ma.5:14 3Mac 5:45 * ;] __1. of place, near. __2. Of degree, almost, nearly: Act.13:44 19:26, Heb.9:22.† (AS)
